schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Kanya Sumangala)
schemes.department: Directorate of Women Welfare, Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Rs.25,000 for a daughter, paid in six parts from her birth until she joins college, straight into the mother's bank account (the father's or guardian's if the mother is not alive). The family applies online at each stage: birth, full vaccination, and admission to Class 1, Class 6, Class 9 and a degree or diploma. The total was raised from Rs.15,000 to Rs.25,000 from 1 April 2024.
eligibility: The family lives permanently in Uttar Pradesh and has proof of residence
Family income is up to Rs.3 lakh a year
Up to two daughters of one family can get it. If the second delivery gives twin girls, all three girls are covered. Legally adopted daughters count within the two
Stage 1 (Rs.5,000) is for a girl born on or after 1 April 2019. Stage 2 (Rs.2,000) is for full vaccination, for a girl born on or after 1 April 2018

Stages 3 to 5 (Rs.3,000, Rs.3,000, Rs.5,000) are for admission to Class 1, Class 6 and Class 9 in the current school year. Stage 6 (Rs.7,000) is for admission to a degree or a diploma of at least 2 years after passing Class 10 or 12
Aadhaar of the applicant, father and mother is compulsory. The girl's own Aadhaar is needed from Stage 3 onward
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant, father and mother (and the girl from Stage 3 onward)
Proof of permanent residence in Uttar Pradesh
Bank passbook of the mother (the father's or guardian's if she is not alive; the girl's own for Stage 6)
Recent photo of the girl
Stage 1: birth certificate number. Stage 2: vaccination card
Stages 3 to 5: admission certificate from the school, or only the Student Unique ID if it is a government school
Stage 6: Class 10 or 12 marksheet, the institute ID and the admission fee receipt
Death certificate if the mother or father has died

demoFields.label: Applicant type
demoFields.hint: Who is applying: mother, father or guardian. A grown-up girl can apply for herself, but only for Stage 6.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: Write it exactly as on the applicant's Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you keep. The OTP, your login ID and password, and every status message come here. One number can be used for only one family.

demoFields.label: District / Block
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now. Choose your town or nagar panchayat instead of a block if you live in a town.

demoFields.label: Mother's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The mother's 12-digit Aadhaar. The father's Aadhaar is asked for in the next box.

demoFields.label: Father's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Needed even when the mother is the applicant. If the father has died, upload his death certificate instead.

demoFields.label: Girl's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: Write it as on the birth certificate. Always use the same spelling at every later stage.

demoFields.label: Category (stage)
demoFields.hint: Choose the stage the girl has reached now. Apply in the same school year as the admission.

demoFields.label: Birth certificate number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the online birth certificate. The portal checks this number by itself.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The mother's own account, linked to her Aadhaar. Copy both numbers from the first page of the passbook.

demoSteps: Open mksy.up.gov.in and tap Citizen Services Portal (Apply Here). Tick I agree, tap Continue and register with your mobile number and OTP. Your login ID and password come by SMS.
Log in and fill in the form: applicant, Aadhaar of the father and mother, address, income declaration, bank account, the girl's details and the stage you are applying for.
Upload the girl's photo and the documents for that stage, then submit. Write down the application number.
The block office (villages) or the tehsil (towns) checks the form, and the District Probation Officer's office approves it. You can see the status after you log in.
After approval the money is paid through PFMS into the mother's account. Check the bank passbook or SMS.

When the girl reaches the next stage, log in again with the same ID and apply for that stage in the same school year. Do not make a new registration for the same girl, or every application for her gets rejected.
schemes.helpline: 181 (Mahila Helpline, UP Women Welfare) / 1076 (CM Helpline); District Probation Officer's office in your district

schemes.title: UP BOCW Shramik Panjikaran (Construction Worker Labour Card)
schemes.department: Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UPBOCW), Labour Department
schemes.brief: Registering with the UP construction workers' board gives a construction worker a labour card. The card opens the family's main benefits: Rs.65,000 for a daughter's marriage, money at childbirth, school and college help for two children, a Rs.1,000 monthly pension after 60, and up to Rs.5 lakh if the worker dies in an accident. Masons, helpers, carpenters, bar benders, plumbers, electricians, painters, tile workers and road and building labourers can all register. You register online with Aadhaar e-KYC (or at a CSC) and renew the card to keep the benefits.
schemes.benefit: Rs.65,000 for a daughter's marriage, Rs.20,000–25,000 at childbirth, Rs.1,000 monthly pension, Rs.5 lakh on accidental death
eligibility: Aged 18 to 60 years
Has done at least 90 days of building or other construction work in the last 12 months
Works in Uttar Pradesh and is not registered with the construction board of another state
Pays a Rs.20 registration fee once, plus Rs.20 for each year of membership chosen (1, 2 or 3 years). One year costs Rs.40 in all
Most benefits (marriage, maternity, serious illness) start after 1 year of membership. The pension needs 10 years of membership and age 60
Benefits go to at most two children, and you must apply within 1 year of the event
documents: Aadhaar card, with OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile for e-KYC
Certificate of 90 days of work from the contractor or employer, or the board's self-declaration form
Family ID or ration card, to add family members
Bank passbook of an account in the worker's own name
Recent colour photo
Mobile number

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The worker's own Aadhaar. Your name, date of birth and address are filled in from Aadhaar after the OTP.

demoFields.label: Enter 6-digit OTP
demoFields.hint: The OTP goes to the mobile linked with Aadhaar. If that number is lost, get it updated at an Aadhaar centre first.

demoFields.label: Mobile
demoFields.hint: Your Aadhaar-linked number or any other number you keep. The approval SMS and login messages come here.

demoFields.label: Family ID / Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: Pick Family ID or Ration Card, enter the number, and the family members appear. Tick each member who should be linked to your card.

demoFields.label: Present Address
demoFields.hint: Where you live and work now, if it is different from the address on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Nature of Work
demoFields.hint: The construction work you actually do, for example helper, carpenter, plumber, painter or bar bender.

demoFields.label: Worked Days (last 12 months)
demoFields.hint: It must be 90 days or more. The work certificate you upload has to show the same number.

demoFields.label: Contractor Name / Contractor Mobile No.
demoFields.hint: The contractor or employer who gave you the 90-day certificate. The office may call this number.

demoFields.label: IFSC / Account Number
demoFields.hint: Your own account. Benefit money is paid only by DBT into this account.

demoFields.label: Registration period
demoFields.hint: Choose 1, 2 or 3 years. Each year costs Rs.20 more. The Rs.20 registration fee is paid only once.

demoSteps: Open labour.upbocw.in and tap Register. Enter your Aadhaar number, tick the consent and verify with the OTP. Your details come from Aadhaar. Then enter a mobile number and set a password.
Log in and complete each part of the profile: personal details, family ID or ration card members, present address, work details and bank details.
Upload your photo and the 90-day work certificate, then tick the self-declaration.
Choose 1, 2 or 3 years and pay the fee online. Save the application number and the payment receipt.
The Labour Enforcement Officer at the district labour office checks the application. You get an SMS when it is approved.
Log in and download your labour card. Renew it up to one month before it expires, because benefits stop on an expired card.
After one year of membership, apply for benefits (daughter's marriage, maternity, children's education) from the same login or at a CSC, within 1 year of the event.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana (Samuhik Vivah)
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department (Samaj Kalyan Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: The UP government spends Rs.1 lakh on each couple married at a mass wedding it organises. Rs.64,000 goes into the bride's bank account, Rs.21,000 is given as household gifts and Rs.15,000 pays for the ceremony. The total was earlier Rs.51,000. It is for brides from poor families of every religion with income up to Rs.3 lakh a year, and also for widowed, abandoned or legally divorced women who are remarrying. The bride applies online with her Aadhaar, and the wedding is held at a block, town or district mass wedding run by the District Social Welfare Officer.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,00,000 per couple: Rs.64,000 to the bride's account, Rs.21,000 in gifts, Rs.15,000 for the ceremony
eligibility: The bride's parents or guardians are permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh. The bride herself must be an adult and applies herself
The family is poor or needy, with income up to Rs.3 lakh a year
On the wedding date the bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21
The bride is unmarried, or is a widow, an abandoned woman or a legally divorced woman who is remarrying
SC, ST and OBC applicants must give a caste certificate. Orphan girls, daughters of widows or disabled parents, and girls with a disability get priority
She must not take marriage money from any other central or state scheme for this wedding
documents: Aadhaar card of the bride and the groom
Age proof of both: school record, birth certificate, voter ID, MGNREGA job card or Aadhaar
Income certificate (family income up to Rs.3 lakh a year)
Residence proof of Uttar Pradesh
Caste certificate (for SC, ST and OBC)
Bride's bank passbook, for an account in her own name linked to Aadhaar
Recent photos of the bride and the groom
For remarriage: the former husband's death certificate or the court's divorce decree

demoFields.label: Document Type
demoFields.hint: Choose Aadhaar. Use the 16-digit VID or a driving licence only if you cannot use the Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: 12-digit Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The bride's own Aadhaar, not her father's. The form is filled in the bride's name.

demoFields.label: Contact mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number the family keeps. The OTP and every SMS about the form, the wedding date and the payment come here.

demoFields.label: Declaration
demoFields.hint: You confirm that no other government scheme is giving marriage money for this wedding. If this is found false, the money is recovered.

demoFields.label: Bride's name / Father's name
demoFields.hint: Write both exactly as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Bride's date of birth
demoFields.hint: She must be 18 or older on the wedding date. Upload the age proof that shows this date.

demoFields.label: District / Block or urban body
demoFields.hint: Choose your block if you live in a village, or your nagar panchayat, nagar palika or nagar nigam if you live in a town.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Write the figure from the income certificate. It must be Rs.3 lakh or less.

demoFields.label: Groom's name / Aadhaar / date of birth
demoFields.hint: The groom must be 21 or older on the wedding date. His Aadhaar is checked again at the venue.

demoFields.label: Bride's bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the bride's own name, linked to her Aadhaar. The Rs.64,000 is paid only into this account.

demoSteps: Open cmsvy.upsdc.gov.in and tap Apply (आवेदन करें), then the link to fill the application. Choose Aadhaar, enter the bride's Aadhaar number and mobile, tick the declaration and tap Verify.
Fill in the bride's, family's, groom's and bank details, upload the photos and certificates, and submit. Write down the form number.

The block verifier (villages) or the urban body verifier (towns) checks the details, and the District Social Welfare Officer approves the form. The status comes by SMS. You can correct a form only after an SMS asks you to.
An SMS gives the date and venue of the mass wedding. The bride and groom go there with their Aadhaar cards, are checked at the venue and are married by their own rites.
The gifts are handed over at the venue. Rs.64,000 is transferred to the bride's bank account after the wedding.
Print the marriage certificate from the portal (Print Marriage Certificate) and keep it for the marriage registration and other records.
schemes.helpline: 0522-2209259 (Samuhik Vivah helpline) / 0522-3538700 (Social Welfare Directorate, Lucknow) / 1076 (CM Helpline)

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan (MMJAA Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: State Agency for Comprehensive Health and Integrated Services (SACHIS), Medical Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Uttar Pradesh's own health cover for poor families who were left out of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. It gives the same Rs.5 lakh a year of free, cashless hospital treatment for the whole family at empanelled government and private hospitals, fully paid by the state. Covered families get the same Ayushman card, made free on the Ayushman portal or app, at a CSC, or at the Ayushman Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital. It has run since 1 March 2019 and is managed by SACHIS.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, same as the Ayushman card
eligibility: Poor families who should have been covered by PM-JAY but were missed in the SECC 2011 list, and were later found in the state's own surveys
All Antyodaya (AAY) ration card families of Uttar Pradesh, added in July 2021
Construction workers registered with the UP BOCW board, and other groups the state government notifies
There is no limit on family size or age. Illnesses you already have are covered from day one
You cannot sign up on your own: the family's name must already be in the list. Check with Am I Eligible on the Ayushman portal or call 1800-1800-4444
Everyone aged 70 and above, whatever the income, gets the separate Ayushman Vay Vandana card
documents: Aadhaar card of the member whose card is being made
Ration card (Antyodaya) or UP Family ID, to find the family in the list
Mobile number for OTP
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC
Labour card, if the family is covered as a registered construction worker
schemes.portalName: Ayushman beneficiary portal (NHA, linked from SACHIS)

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you are making the card for yourself or your family.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you keep. The login OTP and the approval message come here.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: Choose the state Uttar Pradesh. State scheme families are searched from the same Ayushman list. If MMJAA appears in the scheme list for UP, choose that.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Antyodaya families can search by ration card number. Others can search by Aadhaar, Family ID or name.

demoFields.label: Ration card / family number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, search again with the Aadhaar number of the head of the family.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: The Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar. Otherwise choose face authentication on the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets rejected.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in, log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP, choose Uttar Pradesh, and search for your family by ration card, Aadhaar or Family ID.
If your family's names appear, you are covered, whether under PM-JAY or the state's MMJAA. The card and the hospital benefit are the same.
Tap the Aadhaar icon next to a member marked eKYC pending, verify with an Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, take the live photo and fill in the relation, district and PIN code.
Submit. SACHIS usually approves it within a day or two. Then open Download Card, verify with OTP and save the card on your phone.
If your family is not found, ask at the Ayushman Mitra desk of the nearest government hospital or at a CSC, or call 1800-1800-4444. A family that is not in the list cannot be added online.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk. Never pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme.

schemes.title: Ujjwala Free LPG Refill on Holi and Diwali (Muft Gas Cylinder)
schemes.department: Food & Civil Supplies Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, with Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum and HP Gas
schemes.brief: Families in Uttar Pradesh with a PM Ujjwala gas connection get the money for two 14.2 kg refills a year back from the state government: one between October and December (Diwali) and one between January and March (Holi). You book and pay for the cylinder as usual, and the money comes back into your Aadhaar-linked bank account in about 3 to 4 days. There is no form. The only condition is that the connection holder's Aadhaar authentication is done at the gas agency. The UP cabinet approved the 2026–27 round on 9 October 2026.
schemes.benefit: Two 14.2 kg refills a year free, with the money credited back to your bank account
eligibility: A PM Ujjwala (PMUY) gas connection in Uttar Pradesh
Aadhaar authentication (e-KYC) of the connection holder done at the gas agency
A bank account linked to Aadhaar, because the money goes only to the Aadhaar-linked account
One free refill in October–December and one in January–March. A refill outside these months is not refunded
The state approves the scheme again every year. The 2026–27 round runs from October 2026 to March 2027
documents: Aadhaar card of the connection holder
Gas consumer number or the LPG passbook (blue book)
Bank passbook of the account linked to Aadhaar
Mobile number registered with the gas agency
Ration card, if the agency asks to check the family
schemes.portalName: Your LPG distributor (Indian Oil, Bharat Gas or HP Gas)
schemes.submitAt: Nothing to fill in. The Ujjwala connection holder goes to her own LPG distributor (gas agency) in person with her Aadhaar card, the gas passbook or consumer number and the bank passbook, and gets the Aadhaar fingerprint authentication (e-KYC) done for free. Where the oil company's app offers it (IndianOil ONE, Hello BPCL, HP Pay), the e-KYC can also be done at home with Aadhaar face authentication.

demoFields.label: LPG consumer number
demoFields.hint: Printed on the gas passbook and on every cash memo.

demoFields.label: Connection type
demoFields.hint: The refund is only for Ujjwala connections. Ask the agency if you are not sure which type you have.

demoFields.label: Name of connection holder
demoFields.hint: The woman in whose name the Ujjwala connection was given. She must go for the authentication herself.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The connection holder's own Aadhaar. Her fingerprint or face is matched against it.

demoFields.label: Registered mobile
demoFields.hint: The number linked to the gas connection. The booking and delivery messages come here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar authentication
demoFields.hint: It is done only once and is free. If it is pending, you will not get the refund.

demoFields.label: Bank account linked to Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Ask your bank to confirm this account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. The money goes only here.

demoFields.label: Refill booked on
demoFields.hint: Book between October and December for the Diwali refill, and between January and March for the Holi refill.

demoSteps: Ask your gas agency whether your Aadhaar authentication is done. If not, the connection holder goes there with her Aadhaar card and gas passbook and gives her fingerprint. It is free.
Make sure your bank account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. Ask at your bank branch if you are not sure.
Between October and December, book a refill as usual (IVRS call, missed call, WhatsApp or the app). Pay the normal price at delivery and keep the cash memo.
In about 3 to 4 days the money is credited to your Aadhaar-linked bank account. Check the bank SMS or the passbook.
Between January and March, book one more refill the same way for the Holi refund.
If the money does not come, call the Ujjwala helpline 14438 or the UP food department toll-free number, with your consumer number and delivery date ready.
schemes.helpline: 14438 (Ujjwala helpline) / 1906 (LPG emergency) / 1800-1800-150 (UP Food & Civil Supplies toll-free)

schemes.title: Krishi Yantra Anudan — Farm Machinery Subsidy (Yantra Token Booking)
schemes.department: Agriculture Department (Krishi Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: The UP Agriculture Department pays 40–50% of the price of farm machines such as rotavators, seed drills, threshers, sprayers, super seeders, happy seeders and agricultural drones. Farmer groups setting up a farm machinery bank or custom hiring centre get up to 80%. Booking opens online on the Agri Darshan portal a few times a year: in 2026 it opened in February–March and again in July. Selected farmers get a token, buy the machine from a listed dealer, and upload the bill and a photo. After a check, the subsidy is paid into their bank account.
schemes.benefit: 40–50% of the machine price for farmers; up to 80% for farmer groups and machinery banks
eligibility: A farmer of Uttar Pradesh registered with the Agriculture Department, with the registration linked to Aadhaar, land record and bank account
Farm land in your own name, as shown in the Khatauni
Small and marginal, SC/ST and women farmers get the higher 50% share. Other farmers get 40%
A refundable security deposit is paid when booking: Rs.2,500 if the subsidy is Rs.10,001 to Rs.1 lakh, and Rs.5,000 if it is above Rs.1 lakh
One booking per mobile number in each window. Farmers are picked first-come-first-served, or by e-lottery when bookings exceed the district target
The machine must be bought within the days given on the token, or the token is cancelled
documents: Farmer registration number from the Agriculture Department
Aadhaar card
Khatauni (land record)
Bank passbook of the Aadhaar-linked account in the farmer's name
Mobile number for OTP
Caste certificate, for SC or ST farmers
After buying: the dealer's GST bill and a photo of the farmer with the machine, showing its serial number
schemes.portalName: Agri Darshan — UP Agriculture Department portal

demoFields.label: Registration No
demoFields.hint: Your farmer registration number with the Agriculture Department. If you do not have one, register first with Aadhaar, Khatauni and bank details.

demoFields.label: Mobile No
demoFields.hint: The OTP comes here. Only one booking is allowed per mobile number, but you may use the number of a parent, brother, sister, son or daughter.

demoFields.label: District / Block
demoFields.hint: Where your land is. Targets are fixed district by district.

demoFields.label: Scheme
demoFields.hint: Choose the crop residue scheme (CRM) for super seeders, happy seeders, mulchers and balers.

demoFields.label: Machine
demoFields.hint: Choose the exact machine and size. The subsidy amount for it is shown on the screen.

demoFields.label: Farmer category
demoFields.hint: Small and marginal, SC/ST and women farmers get the higher share. It must match your land record and certificates.

demoFields.label: Subsidy amount
demoFields.hint: The fixed subsidy for that machine. You pay the full price to the dealer and this amount comes back to you.

demoFields.label: Security amount
demoFields.hint: Rs.2,500 for a subsidy of Rs.10,001 to Rs.1 lakh, Rs.5,000 above that. It is refunded as the rules say.

demoFields.label: Dealer
demoFields.hint: Buy only from a dealer listed on the portal for that machine, or the subsidy is not paid.

demoSteps: If you are not yet registered, register as a farmer on agridarshan.up.gov.in with Aadhaar, Khatauni and bank details, and note your registration number.

When booking opens (watch the news or ask the block agriculture office), open the portal, go to Kisan Corner, choose Yantra Booking, log in with the registration number and OTP, pick the scheme and machine, and pay the security amount.
Your token is confirmed by SMS, either straight away (first-come-first-served) or after the district e-lottery.
Within the days given on the token, buy the machine from a listed dealer at full price and take a GST bill.
Upload the bill and a photo of yourself with the machine on the portal. The block or district team checks the machine in person.
After the check, the subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT, and the security amount is refunded as the scheme rules say.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-1551 (Kisan Call Centre) / 1076 (CM Helpline); Deputy Director Agriculture office in your district
